name: antigravity-for-copilot
description: Unofficial Antigravity bridge for Copilot Chat: Gemini 3.8 Flash, Claude Sonnet/Opus 4.6/5.5, and GPT-OSS 120B, subject to account availability.

languageModelTools.name: antigravity_generate_image
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Generate a raster image through the installed agy CLI's built-in image-generator subagent, with legacy generate_image support. Returns validated images plus local preview Markdown and Open image links. Include that Markdown in your final answer without changing its file URIs. A generation failure does not imply the CLI is missing; follow the specific error.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Generate an image with the Antigravity backend.

languageModelTools.name: antigravity_web_search
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search the public web with the Antigravity backend through the installed Antigravity CLI's native search_web tool. Returns a concise grounded answer with source URLs.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Search the web with the Antigravity backend.

antigravity.reasoningEffort.markdownDescription: Default thinking effort, used when no **Thinking Effort** is selected in the model picker. The picker selection always wins for that request.

antigravity.showThinking.markdownDescription: Show the model's reasoning. Rendered as Copilot Chat's own collapsible **Thinking…** block where VS Code supports it, and as a blockquote above the answer on builds that do not.

antigravity.efficientToolUse.markdownDescription: Guide Gemini chat models to keep research focused, reuse existing evidence, and group independent read-only tool calls when supported. Respects the requested scope and required checks. Turn off to compare behavior without this advisory guidance.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Never forward tool-call ids. Gemini pairs calls to results by name and does not need them.
Forward ids for Claude models only. The gateway's Anthropic adapter requires a non-empty `tool_use.id`, which it cannot always synthesize.
Forward ids for every model family, including Gemini.
antigravity.toolCallIds.markdownDescription: Forward VS Code tool-call ids on the Gemini wire. Claude models need them because the gateway translates the request to Anthropic, which rejects a `tool_use` block without an id. Gemini pairs calls to results by name, so it is left untouched by default.

antigravity.projectId.markdownDescription: Google Cloud project id to bill requests against. Leave empty to discover it automatically. Set this if you see 403 errors mentioning a project.

antigravity.hiddenModels.description: Model ids to omit from the model picker.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Show only the newest discovered Gemini generation per product line, retaining all its effort tiers, plus discovered Claude and GPT-OSS models. Exclude Flash Lite and internal aliases.
Keep additional discovered generations and Flash Lite; still exclude non-chat/internal aliases and duplicate display names.
antigravity.modelSelection.markdownDescription: Which discovered models to offer in the picker. Availability varies by account and backend. `latest` applies the bridge's curation policy; `all` keeps additional discovered generations. Neither mode adds unavailable model placeholders.

markdownEnumDescriptions: One picker entry per effort tier, e.g. Gemini 3.8 Flash (High) / (Medium) / (Low).
One entry per model, with a **Thinking Effort** control beside it in the picker. Falls back to `#antigravity.reasoningEffort#` when nothing is selected.
antigravity.effortSelection.markdownDescription: How model effort tiers are presented. Antigravity addresses each tier as a separate model id; `setting` folds them into one entry with an effort control next to the model, the way Copilot's own models work.

antigravity.endpoint.description: Pin generation traffic to a single gateway host instead of walking the fallback chain.

antigravity.showStatusBar.description: Show the reported account plan, remaining Antigravity quota, and AI credit balance in the status bar. Hover for account and reset details.

antigravity.cliPath.markdownDescription: Path to the Antigravity CLI used by **Web Search** and **Image Generation**. The extension also checks `AGY_PATH` and the standard Windows installation path when this remains `agy`.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run compile
